composition_subtypes.role: Sort weights ascending to enable greedy adjacent pairing
Enumerate all O(n^2) choices of two people for single kayaks
Greedily pair adjacent in remaining sorted list for min sum

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort all weights, iterate over all pairs to assign single kayaks; for each, pair rest adjacently (greedy) to compute total instability; take min.
payload.rationale: Distinct mechanisms: sorting preprocesses, complete search assigns singles, greedy pairs tandems. Coordinated for optimal min instability.
